job.title: Investor Relations Team Assistant - Maternity cover
job.description:
Summary
Provide a broad range of administrative support (9-10 people) in London (1 in Paris) including, but not limited to:
Manage complex calendars, submitting expenses and departmental invoices, travel arrangements for the Head of CPSG Europe and CPSG team members, coordinate internal and external meetings with investors, and senior executives. Plan and coordinate investor meetings, conferences, and fund-raising events.
Working with the broader administrative team in London and across the other Global offices (New York, Barcelona, Tokyo, San Francisco) to ensure a seamless, consistent and first-rate administrative service for colleagues and their visitors in London.
Working hours: 9.00am to 6.00pm or 8.30am to 5.30pm ( flexible)
Responsibilities and duties
Diary management:

  • Manage multiple calendars in Outlook and schedule internal and external meetings, ensuring appropriate communication details are provided (in person, Zoom, Teams, conference call etc)
  • Book meeting rooms, prepare meeting packs (if required), order food (if required)
  • Ensure particular care and detail when organising international remote, or in-person meetings with senior investment professionals & investors.
  • Ensure that meetings are synced to the CRM database

Business travel:

  • Coordinate investor roadshows from start to end (Aligning multiple flight schedules for back-to-back fund-raising meetings. Sometimes multiple European Cities over the course of a few days, arranging ground transportation throughout the roadshow including hotels).
  • Organise domestic and international travel for the team, in accordance with the Company’s Travel, Entertainment and Expenses policy and procedures.
  • Prepare detailed and accurate itineraries of travel; ensure proactive coordination and tracking of such schedules, which may be subject to change and adjustment

Expenses management:

  • Prepare and submit the team’s individual expenses (whether personal cash or AmEx) in accordance with the Company’s Travel, Entertainment and Expenses policy and procedures
  • Ensure the relevant expenses support documents (e.g. receipts/ invoices) are diligently collected, organised and submitted with expense reports
  • Ensure that all expense reports for the team are submitted in Concur for review and approval in a timely fashion, no later than 60 days after the transaction date.



Events:

  • Assisting heavily with the annual London AGM (Assist with logistics, venue management, travel arrangements, and event materials)
  • Plan and coordinate European conferences for the team and other senior investment professionals (Arranging all flight and chauffeur car bookings, contracts & bookings with the hotels and the conference organizers)
  • Plan and organize fund raising events, such as private breakfasts, lunches and dinners (Coordinate venue sourcing, budgets, bookings, contracts, catering, manage registration platforms and attendee tracking).

Other duties:

  • Updating investor / client information in the CRM database (Salesforce)
  • Ensure that any entertainment planned by the team meets the eligible criteria with compliance, seeking pre-approval as and when required in accordance with company policy
  • Ensure that external guests and colleagues visiting the London office are provided with administrative support, as required
  • Prepare trip agendas, presentations, briefing materials, and meeting packs – includes binding material as required.
  • Provide seamless and administrative coverage for the overall team by guaranteeing that the appropriate and equitably distributed work coverage is in place with the other administrative assistants in London. This includes coordinating an advanced coverage plan for time out of the office, such as annual leave, lunch breaks, home-working etc
  • Answer incoming calls for the team and take detailed messages as required
  • Prepare IT and facilities for new hires into and employee terminations from the team
  • Additional projects and responsibilities as assigned

Behavioural competencies

  • Excellent and proactive communication skills with a variety of stakeholders. Responding promptly with courtesy, clarity and accuracy to inquiries
  • The ability to maintain the utmost level of discretion and confidentiality
  • Strong interpersonal skills and teamwork. Promote co-operation with colleagues and between departments
  • Excellent, consistent service delivery. Understanding, meeting and prioritising the business needs of the team
  • Agility, flexibility, and problem-solving skills
  • Punctuality, organisation and the ability to prioritise work duties, without compromising the level of service
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Team Assistant / Receptionist - Temp to Perm £35K
job.description:
We have a wonderful temporary ( potential for permanent) opportunity if you are a warm, delightful and capable experienced receptionist/ team assistant.
If you're someone who can bring their skills to the table and provide top-notch support across different admin tasks, we want to hear from you please apply immediately! You must have warmth 😊
We're after someone who's proactive, adaptable, and ready to jump in wherever needed. This role is a great chance to be a key part of the team and help keep the office running smoothly.
Key Responsibilities The role will have three main focus areas:
Reception (20%)
▪ Greeting and welcoming guests on arrival.
▪ Answering the phone and taking messages if people are away from their desk.
▪ Managing the switchboard.
▪ Arranging building access passes for employees or guests.
▪ Booking and setting up meeting rooms for internal and external meetings (incl. arranging tea, coffee, and lunches).
▪ First point of contact for the building post room, collecting post/parcels and arranging couriers.

Team Assistant (60%)
▪ Providing primary support including (but not limited to: Coordinating meetings, catering and event management. Making restaurant reservations and coordinating client invites. Coordinating and booking United Kingdom and Global travel for employees and members (train, taxi, flights and hotel arrangements). Finalising and submitting monthly expense reports for the Senior Leaders within the team. Arranging couriers around the UK and Globally mainly using DHL.
▪ Assist with the coordination and execution of office-based events, including new joiner welcome drinks, farewell events, baby showers, and seasonal company functions (summer and winter events)
. ▪ Providing ad hoc support to the Marketing & Client Services team for annual conferences/events – printing, creating packs for clients etc.
▪ Provide ad hoc administration support to employees based in the London office.
▪ Support IT with general enquires and AV room set up.
▪ Organise meetings, preparing collateral and distributing pre-reading packs. Minute taking and recording actions for the meetings.
Facilities (20%)
▪ Calling out contractors or vendors incl. plumbers, etc. where necessary.
▪ Ensuring the office and reception is always clean and tidy.
▪ Maintain a strong working relationship with the cleaning provider, acting as the primary point of contact to ensure service quality and timely issue resolution.
▪ Arranging quarterly window and floor cleaning.
▪ Arranging painting, decorating as well as maintenance when required.
▪ Order office supplies – stationery, fruit & milk, kitchen supplies and cleaning products.
▪ Maintaining a strong working relationship with building management and secretaries/ receptionists on other floors in the building.
▪ Attend quarterly Building Management meetings.
▪ Maintain a strong relationship with the Security office; provide contractor visitor details, loading bay delivery information and provide information for the Monthly Staff List report for them.
▪ Ensure 100% compliance with annual office Health & Safety testing requirements by proactively planning, coordinating, and tracking all mandatory inspections, tests, and certifications within prescribed timelines.
Experience
▪ Previous experience in a receptionist, team assistant, office administrator, or similar support role, ideally within a professional or corporate environment.
▪ Excellent communication skills.
▪ Demonstrated experience in providing administrative support to multiple stakeholders, including diary management, meeting coordination, and travel arrangements.
▪ Effective relationship management with internal and external stakeholders.
▪ Experience handling office coordination tasks, such as managing facilities requests, and liaising with service providers.
▪ Experience using Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and online meeting applications (incl. Microsoft Teams and Zoom
▪ Previous experience in a financial services or professional services environment would be advantageous but is not essential.
Personal Attributes
▪ Professional presents a polished, welcoming presence and represents the organisation positively as the first point of contact.
▪ Effective communication skills, communicate clearly and courteously, both verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders.
▪ Highly organised and manages multiple tasks, schedules, and priorities efficiently with strong attention to detail.
▪ Proactive and self-motivated, anticipates needs, takes initiative, and follows through without constant supervision.
▪ Adaptable and flexible, responds calmly and effectively to changing priorities and a fast-paced environment.
▪ Reliable and dependable, consistently delivers work on time and can be trusted with sensitive and confidential information.
▪ Team-oriented, work collaboratively, provides support where needed, and contributes positively to team dynamics.
▪ Client-focused demonstrates patience, empathy, and a service-oriented mindset when assisting visitors, clients, and colleagues.
▪ Problem-solving mindset, handling queries and challenges pragmatically, escalating issues appropriately when required.
▪ Resilient and composed, maintains professionalism and composure under pressure.

job.title: Team Assistant
job.description:
This is a wonderful role working for one of our favourite clients. We are looking for an articulate, well organised Team Assistant who has a naturally delightful manner and who genuinely enjoys supporting their direct reports and surrounding team. You will be working in a professional but warm environment with wonderful colleagues who help and support each other. A background working in finance and having helped with events is desirable.

Dutes include:
  • General diary Management for the Business Development team (organising internal and external meetings and videoconference calls) & taking ownership of all aspects of meeting organisation (room bookings, catering, technological requirements, materials etc.)
  • Extensive travel management (organising complex trips, visas, itineraries, ground transportation, restaurant bookings)
  • Preparing and maintaining marketing materials (printing, binding, editing, formatting, scanning)
  • Processing monthly expenses, including gifts & entertainment reporting
  • Maintenance of the company CRM system (ensuring information in the system is kept up to date)
  • Organisation of external & internal events, including: the company Christmas party & other staff socials; investor events.
  • HR administrative duties: company scheme administration - medical, travel insurances and new joiner introductions
  • Organisation of Board meetings as directed: scheduling and collating documentation.
General Administrative Duties
  • Provide ad hoc administrative support to the investment team and senior management: scheduling meetings; travel arrangements etc.
  • Answering and fielding/directing incoming calls
  • General administrative duties – filing, binding, printing, couriers, booking taxis
  • Upkeep of office environment and some shared office management tasks
  • Sorting post and incoming deliveries
  • First Aid and fire warden duties (training will be provided)
CORE COMPETENCIES:
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Confident with videoconferencing technology
  • Attention to detail
  • ‘Can do' approach and team player
  • Accountable, productive, efficient
  • Ability to prioritise
  • Smart appearance and professional manner
  • Minimum of 3 days in the office
  • Experience of working in the financial sector would be an advantage
  • Experience of organising events & catering would be an advantage
